amsatStatusSource: AMSAT status page satellite list (https://www.amsat.org/status/), checked 2026-10-19

profile.builtBy: A Jordanian student and engineering team, on the FUNcube design
profile.story: JY1Sat is Jordan’s first satellite, named for the late King Hussein, whose callsign was JY1. Built on the FUNcube design, it carries a linear transponder for SSB and CW and sends down small pictures as SSDV.
